map.8 项保密条款自评得分: Self-assessment score for the 8 confidentiality clauses
map.→ 打开保密管理合规自查工具: -> Open the confidentiality management compliance self-check tool
map.保密管理合规自查 使用指南: Confidentiality management compliance self-check user guide
map.先把得 0 分的关键条款列出，逐项补制度、补培训、补技术管控；得分率低于 60%: List the key clauses scoring zero first and add policies, training and technical controls one by one; a score rate below 60% suggests suspending sensitive business and launching a dedicated rectification, and re-assessment continues until it passes.
map.围绕保密协议签署、培训记录与定期检查，提供合规自查清单与评分，适用于企业保密管理: Centred on confidentiality agreement signing, training records and periodic inspection, providing a compliance self-check list and score for corporate confidentiality management, vetting of confidential posts and internal audit rectification.
map.对外包或驻场人员进场前做保密管理核查，确认其所属条款是否达到'已落实'，不达标者: Before outsourced or on-site personnel enter, run a confidentiality check to confirm their clauses reach "implemented"; anyone not compliant must not access sensitive material.
map.年度保密自查时，对'涉密载体登记、涉密人员审查、保密教育培训、违规外发管控'等条: For the annual confidentiality self-check, score each clause (classified carrier registration, confidential personnel vetting, confidentiality training and control of unauthorised external transmission) as not implemented 0 / partly implemented 1 / implemented 2 and total the score to determine the compliance grade.
map.得分偏低时如何整改？: How to rectify when the score is low?
map.总体合规度 = 各项实得分 ÷ 满分: Overall compliance = actual points earned ÷ full marks
map.新项目立项前做保密管理前置评估，发现薄弱环节（得分为0的项）及时补管控措施，避免: Run a confidentiality management pre-assessment before a new project starts, fixing weak spots (items scoring 0) with controls in time to avoid leak risk after launch.
map.每项三条档位：未落实记 0 分、部分落实记 1 分、已落实记 2 分。总分为各项: Each item has three levels: not implemented scores 0, partly implemented 1, implemented 2. The total is the sum and the score rate = total ÷ (2 × item count). Specific compliance requirements follow your own confidentiality management system and the state secrets law; this tool only aggregates the self-assessment.
map.评分标准是怎么定的？: How were the scoring standards set?
